events.what: Kim, Marklof and Welsh prove the two-point Poisson spectral statistics for a quantum particle in a 3-dimensional rectangular box under a Diophantine condition on the side-length ratios
Lutsko proves Poissonian pair correlation for the relative spectrum of the three-particle trigonometric Sutherland model under a Diophantine condition on the coupling constant
Poissonian correlations of alpha n^d mod 1 (number-theoretic analogue, not quantum spectra of an integrable system)

judgement.doubts: The two cases share the partial tier and have the same AI role (none), so which one the status rests on makes no difference to the codes. Both are preprints nobody has reviewed yet, which doesn't matter for the partial tier. The Pith Review page was never opened and nothing relies on it. The 2605.06974 month comes from its arXiv identifier.
